All acceptance criteria verified. Final state of the change in `src/fact-checker.js`:

```js
// (?!\s*:\s*\d) lookahead rejects matches followed by a ":NNN" line-number suffix,
// so "foo.js:310" is not silently truncated to the bare path "foo.js".
const PATH_EXT_RE = /[A-Za-z0-9_.\-/\\]+\.(?:js|jsx|ts|tsx|py|json|md|csv)\b(?!\s*:\s*\d)/g;
```
